messages:
sam: seeing recurring OOMs on prod-rt-06 during long multi-turn sessions, started ~03:10 UTC, looks tied to KV cache behavior. dump attached in logs. :frowning:

maggie: ugh, any repro yet? which model and kernel path?

sam: 16k context, gptx-16b-quant, kernel=fast-attn-v2, kv_mode=lease-rotation (new flag). crash trace: `OOM: kv_slab_alloc failed (requested=128MB) slab_free=23MB)`. Paging then hard OOM.

ryan: lease-rotation? that's the new scheme where we rotate leases instead of immediate eviction to avoid cache churn, right?

sam: exactly. intended to keep hot prefixes around longer. hypothesis: rotation causes small fragments to stick around while background pager tries to coalesce, but coalesce is slower under heavy batching, so memory spikes.

dave: can you paste the perf counters from the window? I want to see alloc churn and page-fault backlog.

sam: pasted below:
```
KV_TOTAL=12.1GB KV_FREE=0.9GB KV_FRAG_RATIO=0.42 KV_ROTATIONS_PER_MIN=450 KV_SPILLED_PAGES=312 pager_queue_len=18 batch_inflight=48
```

maggie: KV_FRAG_RATIO 0.42 is high. we've seen >0.35 correlate with paging storms.

eng-bot: deploy 2487654200 -> prod-rt-06 completed by ryan 03:05 UTC :rocket:

ryan: that deploy enabled lease-rotation by default for quant pipelines (canary). rolling it back now.

ops-bot: alert muted for prod-rt-06, incident channel #incidents created.

sam: quick mitigation ideas: 1) reduce lease window from 60s -> 8s, 2) force aggressive coalesce when rotation enabled, 3) fallback to immediate-evict when pager_queue_len > 10, 4) soft degrade: route requests >8k ctx to short-context variant.

maggie: I like 1 + 3 as immediate toggles. we can ship a config toggle and flip on prod. add telemetry to track reclaim latency.

ryan: rolling config change: `kv.lease_window_s=8` and `kv.eviction_mode=fallback-on-pager-threshold` on prod-rt-06 now.

sam: applied. memory stabilizing on dashboard. KV_FREE went 0.9GB -> 3.7GB within 90s. page queue dropped to 2.

maggie: nice. long term: we should fix fragmentation cause. maybe switch to slab coalescing on background thread with higher priority when rotations occur. also revisit kernel selection: fast-attn-v2 has larger per-token scratch; potentially amplify frag. test with fast-attn-v1 or split kernel paths based on active-lease_load.

ryan: adding an experiment: run canary with `kernel=fast-attn-v1` + `kv.lease_window_s=30` and measure token latency and mem pressure.

dave: also add a metric: `kv.fragmentation_events_by_alloc_size` (buckets: <64k, 64k-1MB, >1MB). want to see where fragments are coming from.

sam: repro checklist I used: 1) synthetic chat fanout tool hitting 16k ctx, 2) enable lease-rotation, 3) ramp to 45 concurrent streams, 4) sleep 2m, observe pager. I'll upload the harness.

maggie: good. postmortem action items: A) short-term config toggle + rollout (done), B) add fallback path when pager queue > threshold (owner: sam), C) kernel routing heuristics to avoid high-scratch kernels under rotation (owner: dave), D) fragment telemetry + coalesce perf test (owner: ryan).

ryan: scheduling tests in perf lab tomorrow 09:00 PT.

dave: will prototype coalesce priority change and measure cost vs latency.

sam: final note: add an automatic soft-degrade policy: when KV_FREE < 1GB and KV_FRAG_RATIO >0.35, route new requests to short-context variant and inject `x-degraded: kv-fragmentation` header for signal tracking.

maggie: agreed. thanks for quick triage everyone. :thumbsup:

eng-bot: incident resolved (mitigation applied) at 03:18 UTC by ryan.

sam: leaving logs + heap traces in S3: s3://redwood-prod-dumps/prod-rt-06/2487654321/heap-trace-03-10.tar.gz

ryan: keeping this thread open until FRs are shipped. will update when canary finishes. :eyes:
